children: Riot Platforms entered a new custodial arrangement with BitGo Bank & Trust on Oct. 7, 2026, amended Oct. 14, to safeguard its digital assets and cash in segregated accounts, with optional settlement services and required insurance coverage. In connection with this transition, NYDIG Trust will transfer Riot’s assets to BitGo, after which Riot’s custodial agreement with NYDIG will terminate automatically. The BitGo agreement carries a one-year term with automatic annual renewals, monthly fees based on average balances, and a 14-day termination right without an early termination fee. Management expects the move to streamline custody and enhance operational flexibility.
